unstuck_said.text: BlockRun (blockrun.ai) is the team behind the Franklin Agent (autonomous USDC-spending agent, wallet=identity). Filed issue #187 on BlockRunAI/Franklin (github.com/BlockRunAI/Franklin/issues/187): an optional feeless Nano (XNO) settle leg so a block is the receipt for each action settled, trim the per-action cost (provider cost + 5%), with nano-invoice as the order-key binding reference and a live XNO test endpoint.
